verdict.rationale: Plausible is explicitly designed as privacy-first analytics that avoids personal data collection and user profiling — docs and community evidence state it 'collects no personal data,' and information is 'not stored in a way to build user profiles or do fingerprinting.' There is no evidence of cross-device identity resolution or merging anonymous pre-signup activity into an identified profile; this directly contradicts Plausible's core no-tracking design.
